name: [UPD] Grow a Pet! 🐾
desc:
[NOTE]: The game is still under development, expect a lot of bugs.

Welcome to Grow a Pet! 🐾

Relax and grow your very own pet garden! 

Buy seeds, plant them, harvest the pets and gain bucks to get super rare pets! 

Your pets & plants grow while you're offline.

How to favorite pets:
PC - Right Click
Mobile - Hold down on pet for 1 second

🌱 Join the group to share feedback and support the game! 🌱
